description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hapugasthalawa, Kothmale D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Cad. Map No. 330309
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for various parcels in Hapugastalawa. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, owners, and title classifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
